summary: REQUEST_CHANGES。Round-1 F1 已关闭：rematch 会显式 discard queued learning-forward transition，receipt accounting 也纳入该 counter。F2 仍阻断：连续 rematch 可使已被再次 retire 的中间 generation 绕过 predecessor gate，与更老 generation 同时占用同一 (sat,direction) transceiver；无 successor 的 drained generation 还可能延迟 reclaim。另发现 dynamic ISL/lazy endpoint entity cap 交叉漏计，以及 C5/C7 peer-binding 使用错误 origin。

findings.summary: FACT: round-1 F1 CLOSED。queued learning-forward 在 rematch 入 holding 前显式从 open transition 集删除、清空 learning 字段并增加 learning_discarded_at_rematch，避免 re-decision 的 non-deliver KernelError；receipt accounting 已包含该 discard。

FACT/INFERENCE: round-1 F2 remains OPEN。single-transceiver predecessor gate only applies while the generation is not retired. With G0->G1->G2 rematches before G0 drains, G1 can be retired while waiting, wake, skip the gate, and drain control concurrently with G0. Separately, a retired link that drains without a successor does not itself purge/reclaim; the next recompute performs the cap check before purge.

FACT/INFERENCE: max_entities is not globally fail-closed after lazy activation. Endpoint admission ignores live dynamic-ISL delta, while dynamic-ISL admission ignores lazy endpoints, so each check can pass independently while their combined live count exceeds the cap.

FACT: C5/C7 peer-bound queue features use the root sat as _origin_features origin instead of the advertisement's actual origin. After rematch this can zero a valid {peer,value} metric or accept a stale one. Producer schema and routing propagation/queue consumers otherwise perform peer binding correctly.

FACT: authorized regression coverage is insufficient for the required D2 gate. It has a one-rematch control-drain test but no repeated-generation exclusivity/non-overlap test, delayed no-successor reclaim test, combined entity-cap test, or C5/C7 peer-binding regression.

recommendedActions: 修复 F2：把 (sat,direction) transceiver ownership 设计为跨所有 generations 的串行 gate，而不是仅由 current/non-retired generation 检查 retired predecessors；增加 G0->G1->G2 连续 rematch 对抗测试并断言 service interval 不重叠。
让 retired generation drain 完成时可靠触发 reclaim，且在每次 dynamic entity-cap 计算前先结算所有已经 drained 的 generations；增加方向消失后再出现的 cap-boundary regression。
统一 max_entities 的 live-count source of truth，同时计入 lazy endpoints 与未 reclaim 的 dynamic ISL generations；双向创建路径都调用同一 fail-closed 检查。
修复 C5/C7，使 _origin_features 使用每个 CacheEntry 的真实 origin；加入 rematch 后 valid-peer 与 stale-peer 两组回归测试。
本地 Agent 在可执行环境中复现 F2/F3/F4 反例并运行完整授权/相关测试后再决定最终 gate。
